preconditions.description: The road width is at least 1 and at most 10^6.
The number of safety islands is at least 2 and at most min(n + 1, 10^4).
The safety islands are located at points on the road from 0 to n.
The green light duration is at least 1 and at most 1000 seconds, and the red light duration is at least 1 and at most 1000 seconds.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output >= 0 and output <= (g + r) * n)
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 if it's impossible to cross the road, or a non-negative integer representing the minimal time to cross the road.
